problem: Offline reviewer verification could pass caller-selected unkeyed or single-key trust inputs and finalize without revalidating live enrollment state.
cause: Trust pins were supplied at runtime instead of fixed by a committed policy blob; roles shared one key; receipts omitted stable Registry/worktree rechecks.
rule: Bind preflight inputs to an externally pinned authority-signed audit contract and committed tooling policy; use distinct role keys; fail closed; recheck stable Registry lineage, claims, worktree and receipt at signoff.
applies_to: Audit reviewer enrollment, immutable receipts, signoff gates, readiness contracts
